description: This source file defines an asynchronous function to fetch source items from Google Search Console, returning either an empty list or a stubbed list of sources based on configuration settings.

classes.name: SourceItem
classes.description: A schema/model representing a source item fetched from an external source, including metadata such as claim ID, title, URL, snippet, reliability score, stance, provider, and fetch timestamp.

methods.name: List[SourceItem] fetch_gsc_sources(claim_id: str, query: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches source data from Google Search Console based on claim ID and query. Returns a list of SourceItem objects or an empty list if the API key is not configured.

ctags.name: fetch_gsc_sources
ctags.pattern: /^async def fetch_gsc_sources(claim_id: str, query: str) -> List[SourceItem]:$/
